Spend £75 or more on qualifying STANLEY or STANLEY FATMAX hand tools or storage products to claim a FREE STANLEY FATMAX XTREME 120cm Box Beam Level (FMHT43676-1). UK & ROI residents aged 18+ only. Purchase on or between 01.09.2026 - 24.11.2026. Claim online at STANLEYtools.co.uk by 07.12.2026 with proof of purchase. 5,000 available, first come, first served. Full T&Cs apply. Manufacturer promotion.

The 16" Stanley tool box is a compact plastic toolbox built for everyday trade tool storage and site use. The hinged lid with metal clamps provides secure closure, while the water and weather-resistant construction helps protect contents from damp and dust. Three small top organiser compartments are integrated into the lid for storing fixings, fasteners and small components. A padlock eye allows the toolbox to be locked for added security when required. Finished in black and fitted with a practical carrying handle, this non-stacking tool box supports loads up to 6 kg. Suitable for maintenance and light construction work where portable, reliable tool storage is needed.
